An Introduction to the Author

Amine Moulai is a 3rd-year Computer Science student at Université de Perpignan, specializing in AI and automation. Passionate about machine learning, algorithms, and systems, he builds practical, intelligent software that simplifies everyday workflows.

His work spans multi-agent simulations, web intelligence tools, and game development, with a deep interest in exploring the intersection of AI, cognitive psychology, and human behavior.
